derivedTolerance.rule: atol_m = the tightest credited budget among the credited outputs the coordinate determines x |dm/d(dp)|; rods/GuideCurrent: core DP 50 Pa

restartJacobian: block, cached KLU symbolic analysis; colored as test oracle; B = (J(cj=2^20)-J(0))/2^20

frozenGates.afterResult: only on a written root cause that the gate was mis-specified; the original verdict stays red; logged as re-declared after result
frozenGates.pin: harness refuses unless this block's sha256 equals the frozen sha logged as an RP1 row
frozenGates.fills: each TBD fill is its own logged row with the receipt sha
frozenGates.previews: S2-07 and S2-10 results are recorded before any fill that uses them

modelFreeze.exception: the G17 re-base of preparation step G
allowed: commits bitwise-identical by the settled-state regression digest

escalation.ownerReserved: lead decides after a DR-P1 root cause, logs it and reports it to the owner the same day; the owner may overrule (S2-D19)

costMeasurement.solverCpu: process CPU less observation and the ledger's extra evaluation
costMeasurement.observation: observation root-function and output-handler thread CPU, plus every IDASolve call returning at an observation root with IDAGetNumSteps unchanged
costMeasurement.solverWork: every IDASolve call that advanced the step count, less its root-function CPU; event roots are solver work

workBoundPrecheck: a run whose total guard exceeds the remaining bound is not started; S2 is then incomplete, not failed
capRule: 2 x max(budget, projection, S2-10 measured solver CPU for the run kind)

totalGuard.rule: cap + 2 x observed samples x Z5 per-sample observation cost

projection.unitCostRule: Z5 thread-CPU best-of in the quiet window at the frozen code
projection.perRestartRule: medians by restart kind from S2-10 at dcj 0.1

windowCounts.basis: S2-10 window totals 1,312 steps / 112 Jacobians less the six window restarts' regrowth 423 / 101

postWindowCounts.basis: S2-10 20-60 s totals 140 steps / 14 Jacobians are all H1's regrowth, priced in its restart

projection.counting: distinct discrete_restart instants by kind from S2-10

afterOwnerTransaction.scope: transacted owner's algebraic coordinates only; allowlisted by name in the RP5 guard
afterOwnerTransaction.maxPassesDeclared: after the provisional seat (7 passes used)
afterOwnerTransaction.wrmsBoundExcludes: the transacted owner's algebraic coordinates (correction reported)

g18.method: stock IDA (KLU, AMD) over the solids sub-residual; nuclear state, coolant, wall fluxes and SG secondaries frozen

screen.rule: each store meets one of the two at the checkpoint state, evaluated from the laws

preparation.pzrHeater: composed-state PZR metal exterior and head loss, computed once, constant from the consistent start through settling, re-settling and hold

settling.capFit: one exponential per settling quantity on its 20 s range over the last 50% of S2-07; cap = 2 t_fit simulated and 2 x CPU to t_fit
settling.measure: range (max - min) of the 2 Hz-filtered credited output over the window
settling.judgedOn: credited outputs; uncredited cells reported only

hold.averageCoolant: mass-weighted mean liquid temperature of the 27 primary cells

trip.kineticsDomain: D3 (a) as approved: extension per accepted state while the doubled-water-term margin >= 1%; the run ends labelled when it fails; before 60 s the trip is incomplete (red), gates informational to the end, DR-P1 to the owner (S2-D23)

stepTrigger.judgedOn: quiet-window gate run on the code frozen at S2-07

stuckCluster.cluster: highest worth in the source feedback

pencils.restricted: rows and columns of network, SG, SG and PZR metal, rods and guide passages
pencils.coupledNuclearThermal: rows and columns of regional neutron coordinates, the fuel and moderator coordinates carrying feedback, and the network; 1619 as implemented

spectral.complement: held at zero perturbation; no aggregated operator
spectral.solver: dggev: Accelerate on macOS, test-only LAPACK on Linux (S2-D13)

directionalCheck.increment: 1e-5 x min over supp d of scale_i/|d_i|
directionalCheck.scale: max(1,|y_i|) in the coordinate's SI unit at the evaluated state
directionalCheck.kinkRule: reverse d where y+h d crosses a C0 kink, donor flip, relief or mode switch; if both sides cross, exclude and check against the colored path

exactAbsence.rule: phase mass exactly 0, or impulse 0 with inertance 0
exactAbsence.check: analytic column against the colored path
